name: Ootaki Arata
source:
A lively friend of Itsuki. They play retro games together. He often shares his self-styled theories on love, but they are all useless, leading those around him to call him a regrettable handsome man. [spoiler]Despite being mentally exhausted due to constant family discord and his mother being coerced into a "family", he continues his friendships with Itsuki and Nene without showing it outwardly.[/spoiler]
[translated from digital setting materials]
